title: Terrible Old Man
wikitext:
[[Image:TerribleOldMan.png|thumb]]
'''Terrible Old Man''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[607 Water St.]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Fight]]
*+1 [[Luck]]

[[Upkeep]]: Pay 1 [[Focus]] and exhaust to gain 1 [[Sanity]].

== Errata ==
Discard The Terrible Old Man if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.

==Mythos Source==
The Terrible Old Man appears in the short story ''[http://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Terrible_Old_Man The Terrible Old Man]'', written January 28, 1920 by H.P. Lovecraft.  The story deals with the plan of three robbers to attack the title character. He also appears in the short story ''[http://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Strange_High_House_in_the_Mist The Strange High House in the Mist]'', written November 9, 1926.
